remarks: Wonderful mid-century modern home, a timeless design by original owner and architect Howard Weinreich, nestled on a serene lot. Cherished by the same family for decades, this architectural gem boasts clean lines, abundant natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The stone and cypress wood exterior enhances how the house is set on the property. The open-concept living space features floor-to-ceiling windows that frame views of the surrounding landscape. A blend of classic mid-century aesthetics and functional design, the home features a stone fireplace dividing the Living Room and Dining Room, an office with walls of glass to the outside, and an indoor/outdoor room off the back. The lush, private yard offers a perfect retreat with mature trees and space for entertaining. A rare opportunity to own a piece of architecture that combines beauty, craftsmanship, and a legacy of care.
